gatewayClassName.description: GatewayClass for this tenant's Gateway, set from `tenant.spec.gatewayClass`. Empty means the platform default (`_cluster.gateway-class-name`, itself defaulting to the bundled `cilium` class). Whether the class terminates TLS itself or at its provider's edge comes from the platform's `gateway.edgeTerminatedClasses`, so the two cannot get out of step.

tlsPassthroughServices.description: Names (from publishing.exposedServices) whose traffic is TLS-passthrough rather than TLS-terminate. For each such service a dedicated HTTPS listener with tls.mode=Passthrough is rendered on the Gateway, and the service is expected to attach a TLSRoute instead of an HTTPRoute. Rendered only on the publishing tenant, the namespace `publishing.ingressName` names, while `gateway.enabled` is on, and only for names `publishing.exposedServices` lists: the platform TLSRoutes for these services attach to that tenant's Gateway alone, and a passthrough listener anywhere else would reserve its name with nothing behind it. Ignored when this tenant's Gateway is on a class the platform lists in `gateway.edgeTerminatedClasses`: an HTTP-only edge cannot carry a TLS listener, so those services are not published through the tenant Gateway at all.
